{{Quote|Pop-Dog.|Trey Courser, pointing at the female Pop-Dog|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] for a [[Hunt for Stavin Thaal|mission]]. On their way to their [[Toozler's Speeder Repair and Maintenance|base]], they saw the female Pop-Dog listening to a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Unidentified Bith shop owner|shop owner]] who was pleading with her in front of his condemned bakery.<ref name="MK" />

==Personality and traits==
The Pop-Dog was of average height and had a fit build, with a ruddy complexion and a stern face. She maintained a firm demeanor while listening to the pleas of a Bith shop owner, repeatedly shaking her head in response.<ref name="MK" />

==Equipment==
The Pop-Dog wore a [[Color/Legends|brown]] uniform with white triangular insignia resembling teeth sewn along the collar, as well as single tooth insignia on either side of her helmet.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female Pop-Dog was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
